tags.violation_condition: A reference to another printed publication lacks its bracketed printed-publication type, publisher or owning organisation, or place of publication or printing.

when: For other printed publications, such as a printed brochure, rather than books governed by the book-specific place rule.
rules.why: This is the residual printed-publication format, not a general requirement to give a place for every book.
